gui.thaumic_tinkerer.enchanter.cycle: Click to cycle level; after maximum, click to remove.
tc.research_page.thaumic_tinkerer:INFUSE: An infused inkwell holds 800 units of ink. Refill it by surrounding it with eight ink sacs in a crafting grid.
ttmodern.pouch.upgrade_note: Empty the focus pouch before infusion. This prevents its contents being lost during the upgrade. The bottomless pouch holds 117 stacks and cannot contain another pouch.
ttmodern.gate.map_help: Drag / scroll: map  |  0–9: focus  |  Space: home
ttmodern.mirror.upgrade_note: Empty the block talisman before infusion. Sneak-use a solid block to bind its appearance; sneak-use in air to select 3, 5, 7, 9 or 11 blocks per side. Build using plain blocks from your inventory or matching block talismans, including worn rings. Protected placements are skipped without charge.
ttmodern.xp_focus.upgrade_note: Empty the experience talisman before infusion. This prevents stored experience being destroyed by the upgrade. The focus spends actual experience points; a nearly full wand needs proportionally fewer points.
ttmodern.peripherals.analyzer: CC: Tweaked recognizes the analyzer as tt_aspectanalyzer. Its methods are hasItem(), itemHasAspects(), getAspects() and getAspectCount(). The aspect list uses indices starting at 1; the count table maps aspect tags to quantities per item. Reading never consumes the sample. Its GUI shows aspects only after you have scanned the item.
ttmodern.peripherals.golem: Use the connector tool on this block, then sneak-use it on your golem. The golem must stay within 30 blocks along each axis. CC: Tweaked peripheral type: tt_golemconnector. Home and marker changes are immediate. Marker indices start at 1 and dim is a dimension resource ID such as minecraft:overworld. All replacements are validated before changes are applied.
ttmisc.golemconnector.toofar: Cannot bind: golem is outside the 30-block range, belongs to someone else, or the position is protected.
ttmodern.jei.summoning_rules: 3 pedestals; consumes one each. All infused: reusable, 60 s cooldown.
ttmodern.jei.extraction_rules: Kill with the activated cursed blade. Replaces ordinary loot with these souls.
ttmodern.jei.crop_rules: Mature crop; base harvest roll. Ordo traits can add rolls. Seeds are separate.
ttmodern.jei.crop_unknown: This data pack uses conditional or complex loot. Exact preview unavailable.
ttmodern.enderfocus.reset: Focus reset to your vanilla ender chest.
ttmodern.enderfocus.unavailable: Bound EnderStorage is unavailable. Sneak-use obsidian to reset the focus.
ttmodern.bedrock_hint: Sneak-click bottom bedrock to open the portal
ttmodern.enchanter.pillars: Requires six pillars: 2–12 obsidian totems starting at altar height, topped with Nitor.
ttmodern.enchanter.wand: Insert a wand to supply vis.
